WITH plants_sel AS (
SELECT
  p."sitekey" AS plant_id,
  p."sitelabel" AS plant_name,
  om."mttrh" AS mttr,
  om."mtbfh" AS mtbf
FROM "plants" p
LEFT JOIN "plant_record" pr ON pr."sitetie" = p."sitekey"
LEFT JOIN "operational_metrics" om ON om."snapops" = pr."snapkey"
WHERE p."sitelabel" ILIKE /* target plant name pattern, e.g. '%' || :plant_name || '%' */ ''
),
unavailability_per_plant AS (
SELECT
  "plants"."sitekey" AS "plant_id",
  "plants"."sitelabel" AS "plant_name",
  -- compute unavailability U = mttr / (mtbf + mttr)
  -- cast to double precision to avoid integer division issues if types vary
  (
    COALESCE("operational_metrics"."mttrh", '0'::double precision)
    /
    NULLIF(
      COALESCE("operational_metrics"."mtbfh", '0'::double precision)
      +
      COALESCE("operational_metrics"."mttrh", '0'::double precision)
    , 0)
  ) AS "unavailability"
FROM "plants"
LEFT JOIN "plant_record" ON "plant_record"."sitetie" = "plants"."sitekey"
LEFT JOIN "operational_metrics" ON "operational_metrics"."snapops" = "plant_record"."snapkey"
)
SELECT to_char(u.unavailability::numeric, 'FM999990.0000')::text
FROM unavailability_per_plant u
JOIN plants_sel p ON p.plant_id = u.plant_id
WHERE lower(p.plant_name) = lower('solar plant west davidport')
LIMIT 1
